A '''pumpkin''' is a raw [[ingredient]] whose [[intrinsic]] is {{EffectLink|Resistance}}. It can't be eaten raw, but cooked into [[Baked Pumpkin|baked pumpkin]] it grants Resistance for 30 seconds, and its preserve and meal ([[Pumpkin Jam|pumpkin jam]] and the [[Pumpkin Empanada|pumpkin empanada]]) for 3 and 8 minutes.<ref>{{Cite video|quote=Pumpkin, for example, does nothing on its own, but grill it in an oven or a campfire, and you'll find that it gives a very short amount of resistance.}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

Picking up a pumpkin unlocks the baked pumpkin recipe. Baked pumpkin is used in pumpkin jam, the pumpkin empanada and [[Pumpkin Curry Stock|pumpkin curry stock]], which makes [[Pumpkin Curry|pumpkin curry]], the longest-lasting Resistance from food (20 minutes).

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

== Behavior ==
Endermen can only pick up melons, pumpkins and TNT.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/enderman_holdable.json}}</ref>
